name: AWM_ORD_MEASUREMENTS
description: Stores data pertaining to Automatic Wound Measurements usage in Orders.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the order record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this ORD record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: AWM_MEASUREMENT_ROW
columns.description: Contains the FLO IDs of all the measurement rows that were documented with Automated Wound Measurements that are associated with the order. To determine if they are pre or post debridement check item 68511

columns.name: MEASUREMENT_PRE_DEBRIDE_YN
columns.description: Whether or not the measurement from the row in 68510 is a pre or post debridement measurement.
